identification: Lot of: a black-lacquered/painted serving tray with floral (poppies, daisies) decoration and rustic edge; a small country-style timber box with hinged glass-topped lid containing a rooster/chicken picture; four resin/composition Australian animal figures on timber bases with small brass plaques (Tasmanian devil, wombat, koala, thylacine) plus a spare base. Maker not identified, plaques unreadable; looks like a 1990s Tasmanian souvenir series.
